pile.runningNote: It can take a few minutes. The themes appear here as soon as it's done.
pile.noOpenThemes: The analysis is done, but there are no open themes to show. You'll find them in the Research.
pile.network: The connection dropped. Check the network and try again: if the analysis had already started, wait a minute and press again.
pile.idle: It lights up with the first response.
pile.scanHelp: Scan and answer from your phone. No account needed.

formOff.title: The form is off.
formOff.text: Anyone who scans the QR code won't find the form.
formOff.action: Turn the link back on in Collect

formFull.title: The form is full.
formFull.text: The Free plan takes up to 100 feedback: new responses no longer come in.

hypothesesNote: The verdict of the hypotheses comes with the themes.

verdictView.heading: The verdict
verdictView.failed: The verdict didn't come through and doesn't count toward the monthly limit. Run it again from the Research, with “Verdict only”.
verdictView.limit: Only one analysis was left this month and it went to the themes: the verdict wasn't run.
verdictView.none: No hypothesis got a verdict. The details are in the Research.
verdictView.themesFailed: The themes didn't come through and don't count toward the monthly limit: the verdict did.
verdictView.noThemes: No themes yet: the answers are too few or too different from each other. That doesn't count toward the monthly limit: the verdict does.
